title: centaurea triumfettii subsp. stricta
intro: Centaurea triumfettii subsp. stricta, commonly known as the strict Centaurea, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health issues. The strict Centaurea is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties.
